def main():
    num = int(input())
    str_input = input()
    working_str = str_input
    brackets = "_"
    start_pos = -1
    total_len = len(working_str)

    idx = 0
    while idx < total_len:
        ch = working_str[idx]
        if ch == '(':
            start_pos = idx
        elif ch == ')':
            brackets += working_str[start_pos + 1:idx] + "_"
            working_str = working_str[:start_pos] + "_" + working_str[idx + 1:]
            total_len = len(working_str)
            idx = start_pos - 1
            start_pos = -1
        idx += 1

    bracket_parts = brackets.split("_")
    bracket_count = sum(1 for part in bracket_parts if part != "")

    segments = working_str.split("_")
    max_len = max((len(segment) for segment in segments), default=0)

    print(f"{max_len} {bracket_count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
